title: The Student Experience
bio: Teo Nicolais is a highly accomplished real estate entrepreneur and educator, holding multiple prestigious designations including the CRE, CCIM, CPM, and CAPS, making him one of only 17 people globally to hold all three major real estate credentials. Nicolais also has practical experience in the field as the President of his own real estate investment company, Nicolais, LLC, and has served in various leadership roles in real estate organizations
